text: ∀x (Sport(x) ∧ PlayedBetweenTwoTeamsOnFieldWithBall(x) ∧ ObjectiveToScorePointsByGettingBallIntoOpposingTeamGoal(x) → GoalBasedSport(x)) ::: A sport that is played between two teams on a field with a ball and the objective is to score points by getting the ball into the opposing team's goal is a goal-based sport.
